guideSupportedDetails.paraphrase: Procedure resembles Shoufu, secret material only issuer (team-mode exception), maximum all-use target count independent of the matched category.
Six basic declarations, virtual no-suit/no-rank identity, normal/fire/thunder Slash matching treated same, outgoing/incoming directional horse effects.

guideSupportedDetails.caveat: Explicit failed match returns to ordinary native response; wording 类别不一致 lacks a concrete opposing Slash example and must not be elevated to exclusive FAQ.

implementationInferences: Guide X is the maximum final designated-target count of one use among all types; matching the seal category is an independent condition. Repeated effect rounds retain the same native use identity.

Native true-use declarations and accepted true Dodge/Nullification responses are counted; pure played Slash responses to Duel/Barbarian are excluded. Legacy Action-null native uses count. The final legal actor/targets determine the completed use; native faction-provided Dodge remains pure played under the existing native response-completion contract; actual supplied Slash Use has its own native declaration and actual user.

A seal leaves Hand for a private character zone and therefore uses its physical category after continuous Hand-only identity ceases. Its issuer alone sees the sealed identity; this engine has no additional ranked teammate-sharing rule.

The exact seal is removed first, its real movement children drain, then current actual-turn history is evaluated. Subsequent draw children do not recalculate an issued reward. There is no exclusive FAQ for nested child timing.
A paid deposit survives source loss; a dead issuer receives no cards but the mandatory holder Ending still removes the entity. Holder death removes it through native death cleanup.

Weijie basic Slash-name matching across three Slash natures follows the detailed same-product guide; no suit/rank is manufactured. Failure returns the original native request. Its off-turn allowance and frozen provider/requester are exact actual-turn implementation inferences, not an exclusive FAQ.

A paid wrong-name attempt consumes only Weijie, and reissues a fresh canonical prompt for the same still-current living native requester/provider, response count and cursor. No availability shortcut may manufacture a decline, apply Duel damage, transfer a Borrowed Sword weapon or skip a faction provider. A later actual native answer owns that outcome.

The cost is one actual foreign Hand discard, privately selected through the opaque native hand boundary at exact outgoing distance one. Its frozen effective basic name is compared once; the discarded physical entity never becomes a material of the issued card.

A successful native Use has zero physical materials, Suit.None and rank zero with colorless appearance. A genuine native played Response uses its existing empty-material response appearance and exact actor/provider/requester; pure Duel and group played responses are not promoted to true Uses.

The off-turn allowance belongs to the actual turn and provider, surviving source loss and reacquisition. A paid continuation retains its exact cost and native parent through real movement, damage, source-loss and dying children. A dead payer issues no new card and follows the exact original native return.

Off-turn ordinary Alcohol retains the existing ordinary Alcohol quota query and actual-turn expiration. Cao Chun initial active Play remains an own-actual-turn boundary; no simulated foreign activation is claimed as a reachable Weijie request.
